verification.notes: Michael Aquino was an Army psychological-operations officer and founded the Temple of Set. Contemporary reporting and the later appellate record show child-abuse allegations were investigated without charges; Army officials said his religion was constitutionally protected and irrelevant to military service, contradicting the claimed causal reason for hiring him.
